_comment: Single registry of the sites this repo manages. Adding a new site means adding
one entry here -- the admin-subdomain scripts read this file so a new site does
key          short slug used on the command line and in bucket names (no dots)
id           WEBSITE_ID in the CMS database / MCP server
domain       registrable domain, as registered at GoDaddy
analytics    GA4 measurement id, or empty
dns          where the authoritative DNS lives: godaddy | route53
configPrefix filename prefix in react/baseProject/configs/ for this site's
build assets. NOT always the same as key -- ldsfaithincrisis
uses 'faithInCrisis'. null means no config set exists yet.
publish-static-pages.ps1 and regenerate-sitemaps.ps1 still carry their own
inline $sites tables; they predate this file and were left alone.
'excluded' lists domains this tooling must NOT touch, with the reason. They are
kept here rather than deleted so the reason survives -- Resolve-Site reads it and
refuses the key with that explanation instead of a bare 'unknown site'.

excluded.reason: Not a React SPA. It is a hand-built static site (no script tags, its own fonts/stylesheets, a hand-authored homepage with client reviews) and is already fully crawlable, so the prerender migration has nothing to gain. Worse, its CMS record holds a single 2KB article, so -Phase root would overwrite the 8.5KB hand-built homepage with that render and destroy the design. Verified 2026-07-29.
